question: What is the primary legal condition under which abortion is permitted in Nigeria?

options.A: To save the life of the pregnant woman
options.B: When agreed upon by both biological parents
options.C: In cases of proven financial hardship
options.D: Upon request during the first trimester

explanation: Nigerian law is restrictive and only allows termination of pregnancy if the mother's life is in direct danger. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h1)

question: Why do restrictive legal frameworks contribute to high rates of clandestine abortions?

options.A: They drive women to seek unregulated and unsafe providers in secret
options.B: They eliminate the availability of all medications in the country
options.C: They encourage patients to travel abroad for routine healthcare
options.D: They force government hospitals to offer free surgical terminations

explanation: When legal options are absent, individuals rely on hidden, unqualified practitioners, which increases health risks. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h1)

question: What is the most immediate life-threatening complication following an unsafe abortion?
explanation: Acute bleeding from incomplete tissue removal or uterine damage can quickly lead to shock and death if untreated. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h2)

question: A patient presents with fever, lower abdominal tenderness, and foul-smelling vaginal discharge days after an abortion. What is the priority nursing suspicion?
explanation: Foul discharge and fever in this context strongly indicate ascending infection and pelvic sepsis from unsterile procedures. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h2)

question: What condition involving intrauterine adhesions often follows aggressive uterine curettage?
explanation: Trauma to the basal layer of the endometrium creates scar tissue that obliterates the uterine cavity, causing Asherman syndrome. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h3)

question: How does pelvic inflammatory disease from an unsafe abortion affect future pregnancies?

options.A: It causes the placenta to detach early during normal labor
options.B: It eliminates all hormonal production in the corpus luteum
options.C: It permanently prevents ovulation from occurring in the ovaries
options.D: It causes tubal scarring that raises the risk of ectopic pregnancy

explanation: Blocked or damaged fallopian tubes impede the normal transit of a fertilized egg, leading to ectopic implantation. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h3)

question: Why do many Nigerian women avoid seeking help for psychological distress after an unsafe abortion?

options.A: Availability of free mental health clinics everywhere
options.B: Belief that psychological trauma resolves on its own
options.C: Fear of social stigma and legal repercussions
options.D: Mandatory reporting laws that protect patient identity

explanation: Stigma and the criminalization of abortion create barriers that force patients to hide their emotional and physical pain. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h4)

question: Which psychological condition is commonly reported among survivors of complicated unsafe abortions?
explanation: The trauma, fear, and physical toll frequently trigger significant depressive symptoms and anxiety disorders. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h4)

question: A young woman presents with lower abdominal pain and tachycardia after visiting a local chemist. What is the first nursing action?

options.A: Assess vital signs and stabilize her physical condition
options.B: Discharge her with analgesics and a referral for counseling
options.C: Report the chemist immediately to local law enforcement
options.D: Question her sternly about why she sought an abortion

explanation: Immediate stabilization and assessment of vital signs take priority in any emergency clinical presentation. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h5)

question: Why is maintaining strict patient confidentiality essential during the nursing assessment?

options.A: It eliminates the need to record vital signs in the chart
options.B: It is required to protect the nurse from legal prosecution
options.C: It builds trust and encourages accurate clinical disclosure
options.D: It prevents family members from visiting the patient

explanation: Given the stigma and legal risks, patients will only share accurate health histories if they trust their information is private. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h5)

question: What is the primary purpose of Manual Vacuum Aspiration in post-abortion care?

options.A: To permanently sterilize the patient against future pregnancies
options.B: To treat severe systemic sepsis without using antibiotics
options.C: To safely empty retained products of conception from the uterus
options.D: To measure the exact hormone levels circulating in the blood

explanation: Manual Vacuum Aspiration is an effective, standard method used to remove remaining tissue and stop hemorrhage. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h6)

question: Why is contraceptive counseling considered a core component of post-abortion care?

options.A: It helps prevent repeat unwanted pregnancies and subsequent unsafe procedures
options.B: It replaces the need for surgical evacuation of the uterus
options.C: It completely cures any underlying reproductive tract infections
options.D: It is legally mandated before any patient can leave the hospital ward

explanation: Providing immediate family planning counseling reduces the incidence of recurrent unintended pregnancies and subsequent unsafe abortions. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h6)

question: How do nurse-led community outreach programs help reduce rates of unsafe abortion?

options.A: By strictly forbidding teenagers from engaging in any social activities
options.B: By arresting illegal practitioners operating within local neighborhoods
options.C: By distributing contraceptives and educating the public on family planning
options.D: By lobbying the government to remove all restrictions on abortion

explanation: Community education and accessible contraception address the root cause of unsafe abortion by preventing unintended pregnancies. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h7)

question: An adolescent visits a clinic asking for birth control advice. What is the most appropriate nursing response?

options.A: Refuse service and lecture the adolescent on moral standards
options.B: Report the visit immediately to the local community elders
options.C: Tell the patient to return only after getting married
options.D: Provide non-judgmental education and accessible contraceptive options

explanation: Offering confidential, non-judgmental contraceptive guidance protects young people from unintended pregnancies and unsafe procedures. [learn more](GNS226_U5_T026#GNS226_U5_T026_h7)
